page 0 ORB of 19
panel ORB -
act "RING" RING
param ORBIT.KEY "KEY" choice lin 0 11 1 0 -
opt ORBIT.KEY 0 "C"
opt ORBIT.KEY 1 "C#"
opt ORBIT.KEY 2 "D"
opt ORBIT.KEY 3 "D#"
opt ORBIT.KEY 4 "E"
opt ORBIT.KEY 5 "F"
opt ORBIT.KEY 6 "F#"
opt ORBIT.KEY 7 "G"
opt ORBIT.KEY 8 "G#"
opt ORBIT.KEY 9 "A"
opt ORBIT.KEY 10 "A#"
opt ORBIT.KEY 11 "B"
param ORBIT.SCALE "SCALE" choice lin 0 10 1 0 -
opt ORBIT.SCALE 0 "MAJOR"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 1 "MINOR"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 2 "DORIAN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 3 "PHRYGIAN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 4 "LYDIAN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 5 "MIXOLYD"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 6 "LOCRIAN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 7 "HARM MIN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 8 "PENT MAJ"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 9 "PENT MIN"
opt ORBIT.SCALE 10 "CUSTOM"
param ORBIT.BARS "BARS" cont lin 0 7 1 0 -
act "SCENE" SCENE
param TEMPO.BPM "BPM" cont lin 30 300 1 120 -
OK
